# Page header actions

<!-- Generated by php artisan standards:install from tey/standards; do not edit. -->

A page header shows up to three actions written out by name in a ButtonGroup (one filled primary at most), with the rest in its

Scaffold: `php artisan standards:make page --flavor=show <Name>`.

Kit: @kit/ui Page, @kit/ui ButtonGroup, @kit/ui InertiaAction, @kit/ui DropdownAction.
- `Page` from `@kit/ui` for the page header: The #actions slot holds the header's ButtonGroup (props: #actions, status).
- `ButtonGroup` from `@kit/ui` for the action group: The visible actions, then the rest in #menu (props: default slot, #menu).
- `InertiaAction` from `@kit/ui` for the action button: A named server action as a button (props: action).
- `DropdownAction` from `@kit/ui` for the menu action: A named server action in the #menu (props: action).
Checks: ui header-actions. Run `php artisan standards:check --changed` before committing.

Conventions:
- Write the actions out by name (Jasper, fleet-wide): the server sends a keyed map of Action descriptors (null or absent means not allowed), and the #actions slot places each in a ButtonGroup with InertiaAction, the rest as DropdownAction in its #menu. A catch-all renderer (Page :actions, ActionBar, FloatingToolbar :actions) is not the default.
- At most one filled primary and three visible actions; the rest go in the #menu.
- On phone only the primary stays visible; everything else is in More. A status (saving, saved, error) goes in the #status slot or the status prop, which is aria-live polite.

Not sure this is the right leaf? It answers "Where do the actions sit?" Call bakery.find, or run `php artisan standards:pattern --recipe=ui-page.header-actions` to see its siblings.
